tldr: Irreversible allocations have an exactly computable positive leading nonanticipation price under the complete stationary polynomial reporting-tail class and the prescribed progressive head channel. Reporting lag begins when the endpoint is due. The separately imposed majority-on-schedule benchmark bounds the observed masses. The price is \(C(\alpha,L)T^{-\alpha}+o(T^{-\alpha})\), with \(C(\alpha,L)=LC(\alpha,1)\). Rational shared-head primal and stationary-tail dual certificates determine the constant to any requested accuracy and recover attaining designs. Causal cumulative action rounding closes the finite-policy mesh approximation in both directions. Pilot-based shifted-head tables attain the same benchmark under the sequential cohort-size and horizon limits, and simultaneously when \(N_T/(T^{4\alpha+2}\log N_T)\to\infty\), with explicit quantization and optimization tuning.
